title: Lloyds (LYG) Launches “Lloyds Rewards” In-App Hub to Replace Everyday Offers
title_zh: 劳埃德 (LYG) 推出“劳埃德奖励”应用内中心以取代日常优惠
summary: ​Lloyds Banking Group (NYSE:LYG) is one of the top value stocks to buy under $10. On June 9, Lloyds launched a new in-app hub called “Lloyds Rewards,” replacing its previous “Everyday Offers” to provide customers with an integrated space for savings, cashback, and prize draws.
summary_zh: 劳埃德银行集团（纽约证券交易所股票代码：LYG）是 10 美元以下最值得买入的股票之一。 6 月 9 日，劳埃德推出了一个名为“劳埃德奖励”的新应用内中心，取代了之前的“每日优惠”，为客户提供储蓄、现金返还和抽奖的综合空间。

title: How SpaceX benefits from its Cursor acquisition
title_zh: SpaceX 如何从收购 Cursor 中获益
summary: SpaceX's SpaceXAI should get a solid boost from its Cursor acquisition, but it will still need to compete with rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic.
summary_zh: SpaceX 旗下的 SpaceXAI 应该会从 Cursor 收购中获得坚实的推动力，但它仍然需要与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等竞争对手竞争。

title: Morgan Stanley (MS) Buys Into UK Rentals With £1.045b Metra Living Deal
title_zh: 摩根士丹利 (MS) 以 1.045 英镑收购英国 Rentals Metra Living 交易
summary: Morgan Stanley Investment Management and Ridgeback Group agreed to acquire Metra Living, the PRS business of London & Quadrant Housing Trust, for £1.045b. The deal expands NYSE:MS into UK residential rental assets at a time of housing supply constraints in key urban areas.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利投资管理公司和 Ridgeback Group 同意以 1.045b 英镑收购 London & Quadrant Housing Trust 的 PRS 业务 Metra Living。在主要城市地区住房供应紧张之际，该交易将 NYSE:MS 扩展到英国住宅租赁资产。
